items.summary: Recommend financial containment: retain only the existing canonical allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement after capacity release; do not approve new discretionary implementation, AI expansion, marketing spend, forecasts, ROI claims, or site-level revenue claims until budget and attribution controls improve. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission. The full $4.92 is an aggregate provider row; site-attributed income is $0, so no site revenue or contribution margin is supported. September AI usage is $1,002.46 across 5,531 calls, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors. Infrastructure, registrar, hosting, labor, and other variable costs are absent; monthly spend limit, fixed costs, marketing budget, revenue target, and revenue floor are blank. Therefore contribution margin, cost-to-learn, total budget variance, payback, and ROI are not calculable. Minimum measurement: a dated cost ledger linking AI and infrastructure costs to site/work/experiment IDs, plus provider revenue exports with stable site tracking IDs and a common reporting period. Do not move money, alter billing, or make external commitments.

Conditionally retain the canonical work-lifecycle and AI cost-guardrail proposals as control-plane designs only, after capacity clears. They may use existing records and must not claim savings, margin improvement, or cost-to-learn until measured. Require before implementation: explicit owner-approved budget ceilings, cancellation/retry thresholds derived from observed distributions, durable-output linkage, and a before/after cost-per-completed-output report. Do not create duplicate telemetry or approve external spend.
